notes.title: Added Oculus Rift&Touch support
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27831095/cf3d43382ec386367f05ca3de9b68b047ac52999.jpg[/img]
Added: 
[list]
 [*]Oculus Rift & Oculus Touch support
 [*] Zombie Boss on the level "City" and "Farm"
[/list]
Fixed:
[list]
    [*]The availability of weapons after the first activation
    [*]Spawn zombies on the level "City"   
[/list]
